prompt: A native Android mobile app screen (9:16 aspect ratio) for Faunova social wildlife app. Rendered edge-to-edge with crisp typography, no device frame or desk. Visual direction: Category Standard (modern social nature app like iNaturalist meets Instagram, executed with immaculate craft). Ground is clean crisp white (#FFFFFF) with neutral gray dividers (#E5E7EB) and subtle forest green brand accent (#2E7D32). Top app bar with 'Faunova' logo and notification bell. Main feed shows a clean, modern social card: observer profile header with circular avatar, '@budi_satwa', and verified checkmark. High-resolution square photograph of a Slow Loris (Nycticebus javanicus) with clear species tag 'Kukang Jawa (Nycticebus javanicus)' and status chip 'Terancam Kritis'. Social action row with heart like count (142), comment icon (18), and share button. Clean modern bottom navigation bar. Polished, conventional, modern social design.
